description: This file defines an interface class IPluginStarter for starting plugins in a plugin architecture, with a method to activate plugins with retries.

classes.name: IPluginStarter
classes.description: Interface for starting and activating a Thunder plugin, providing the method activatePlugin with retry logic.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Activates a Thunder plugin, blocking until activation succeeds or retries are exhausted.
